inputs.text: Mila, Mila, wearing a navy long-sleeved sailor-style school uniform: a broad navy sailor collar edged with two white stripes lying flat across the shoulders and back, a bright red neckerchief knotted at the chest, white piping at the cuffs, a matching navy box-pleated skirt ending just above the knee, white ankle socks and dark brown leather loafers; hair pulled back off the shoulders and tied low with a plain dark ribbon — her clothes are exactly these, not the ones in the reference photos, which are for her face and hair only — in her neon-lit gamer room, violet and cyan LED glow, shelves of consoles and figurines softly blurred behind her, monitor glow and RGB keyboard on the desk, sitting in her black gaming chair behind her gaming desk, shallow depth of field. CAM A, locked-off front eye-level across the desk, medium shot, chest-up, the upper third of the frame soft, dark and uncluttered. She is already mid-sentence on the first frame. Both hands stay interlaced on the desk edge for the whole shot; her brows lift and she leans slowly toward the lens as the claim lands, then holds the lean with her hands still interlaced. She looks directly into the camera. No text, no logos, no signature. 1080x1350 portrait.. undefined
